product_one_liner.value: AmplifAI helps contact-center teams improve performance and customer experience through AI-powered quality assurance, coaching and gamification.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the navigation or footer; buyers are directed to request a demo. The pricing URL did not expose plans or prices.

named_customers.notes: Named in the company’s financial-services customer logo wall.

hq_location.notes: The headquarters address is in Plano, Texas.

founded_year.notes: Company-hosted articles state 2016, but its 2025 funding announcement instead states 2018; public sources conflict.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains buyer’s guides, coaching guidance, industry analysis and company news, rather than engineering-authored accounts of how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation, help-center or developer-portal link was found in the homepage navigation/footer. The learning hub provides promotional feature overviews and CX guidance rather than product-use documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists only Senior .Net Full Stack Developer – Plano, with no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: LLaMA, hosted internally within AmplifAI’s secure cloud.
model_provider.notes: The company explicitly names internally hosted open-source LLMs such as LLaMA.

compliance_certs.notes: The company describes SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 as certified, and HIPAA, PCI DSS and GDPR as self-compliant.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 23, 2025. The $33.7 million total includes Series B funding and a credit facility; an equity-only amount is not separately disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 23, 2025 financing falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists only Senior .Net Full Stack Developer – Plano, with no SDR, BDR or account-executive opening.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying dated launch announcement was found within May 9–November 9, 2026. The AmplifAI 3.0 announcement is dated November 10, after the requested cutoff; it does not give an exact unveiling date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Leslie Goodwin’s profile lists joining AmplifAI as Vice President Client Integration in January 2026, followed by Sr. Vice President, Healthcare Strategy & Growth in May 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: HubSpot is preferred in a sales-role requirement. Salesforce, Zendesk and ServiceNow are listed CRM integrations, not confirmed internal deployments.
